title: DoSync Intent
description: A semantic goal submitted to the DoSync hub. Expresses *what* should happen, not *how*.

intent.description: Intent class name. Must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$. Five universal classes are built into every hub (ensure_safety, alert_anomaly, control_access, report_status, notify). Domain-specific classes are registered via POST /v1/intent-classes.

intent_id.description: Unique identifier for this intent instance. Auto-generated by the hub if omitted. Format: int-{unix_timestamp}-{6-char hex}.

urgency.description: Execution urgency. 'emergency' bypasses all policy constraints. 'alert' may trigger confirmation policies. 'info' and 'warning' are subject to all policies including rate limits.

source.description: Component that fired this intent. Used for per-source rate limiting.

subject.description: Optional subject of the intent (e.g. 'grandmother', 'children'). Used by resolvers to narrow scope.

context.description: Arbitrary key-value context data. Used by the resolver for scoring (e.g. 'location') and by adapters to build action parameters.

constraints.description: Execution constraints. Passed through to the policy engine and executor.

require_confirmation.description: If true, the policy engine must confirm before executing. Overridden by 'emergency' urgency.

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch) when the intent was created. Auto-set by the hub if omitted.
